question: Saurashtra won the Vijay Hazare Trophy 2022 by defeating:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saurashtra defeated Maharashtra by 8 wickets in the final match of the Vijay Hazare Trophy 2022.**
 
• **This was Saurashtra's second Vijay Hazare Trophy title, having previously won in 2019-20.**
 
• Karnataka and Delhi were both semi-finalists in the tournament but were not the teams that Saurashtra defeated in the final.
 
• Andhra did not make it past the group stage of the tournament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Vijay Hazare Trophy is a domestic one-day cricket competition in India.**
 
• The competition bears the name of the renowned Indian cricket player from the** **20th century, Vijay Hazare.
 
• It was inaugurated in the 2002–03 season.
 
• Tamil Nadu has won the trophy five times, making them the most successful team.
 
• **Saurashtra is a cricket team from the state of Gujarat.**
